user_story: As a staff member, I want to confirm a booking so that the guest knows their reservation is secured.

positive.title: Confirm a booking successfully
steps: Log in as a staff member.
Verify that a confirmation message is displayed.
positive.expected_result: The booking is confirmed, and the guest receives a confirmation notification.

positive.title: Confirmation of multiple bookings
steps: Log in as a staff member.
Verify that confirmation messages are displayed for each booking.
positive.expected_result: All selected bookings are confirmed, and guests receive confirmation notifications.

negative.title: Try to confirm a booking that does not exist
steps: Log in as a staff member.
Try to select a non-existent booking.
negative.expected_result: An error message is displayed indicating that the booking does not exist.

negative.title: Confirm a booking without staff login
steps: Attempt to access the bookings section without logging in.
negative.expected_result: An error message is displayed indicating that login is required to confirm bookings.

edge.title: Confirm a booking with the earliest check-in date
steps: Log in as a staff member.
Select a booking with the earliest check-in date.
edge.expected_result: The booking is confirmed successfully, and the confirmation message indicates the earliest check-in date.

edge.title: Confirm a booking close to system timeout
steps: Log in as a staff member.
Wait for the system session timeout.
edge.expected_result: An error message is displayed indicating that the session has expired and the user must log in again.
